text:
Sam: Quick UX callout on the model catalog — when you open the compare table with lots of performance badges the row height jumps and the filter pills collapse on narrower viewports. Need a quick decision: truncate badges, wrap pills to a second line, or make pills horizontally scrollable? Screenshots in thread.

Anya: I ran a quick mock — prefer keeping a single pill row and allowing horizontal scroll for the pills. For badges: move them into a fixed-width column that truncates with a +N overflow badge and tooltip. Keyboard/AT: pills must be tabbable and announce counts (e.g., "Filters (3)"). Mock link: https://www.figma.com/file/... :design:

Mike: @Anya horizontal scroll is doable but we need to watch virtualization + sticky headers. Scroll container inside a virtualized row can cause layout thrash. Suggest a visible scroll affordance (fade gradient) and keyboard support (arrow keys). For badges we can show max 3 inline + a "+N" pill. Prototype CSS idea:
```
.badges { display:flex; gap:8px; min-width:120px; align-items:center; }
.badge--more { opacity:0.85; cursor:pointer }
```
I'll prototype this.

Jorge: A11y nit: the green used for the performance badge fails AA at small sizes. Recommend swapping to token `success-600` and always include an icon + text (don’t rely on color alone). Also add aria-labels like "latency: 22ms (p95)" so screen readers get the metric.

Priya: Microcopy: keep it consistent with the global filter bar. Use "Active filters (3)" rather than just "Filters" when filters are applied. For pin UX the current label "Pin version" reads a bit vague — consider "Pin to comparison" so the intent is clear.

Anya: For the pin affordance: move the pin icon next to the version dropdown, tooltip: "Pin this model version so it stays in comparisons". Small hover animation is OK, but keep it subtle (reduce motion users should not see it).

Mike: I'll spin up an interactive prototype with keyboard horizontal scroll + the +N badge behavior. @design-bot can you upload the updated frame once done? ETA: today. :thumbsup:

design-bot: Figma frame uploaded — https://www.figma.com/file/.../catalog-compare-iter2 — comments enabled for @Anya @Mike @Jorge.

Sam: Great, thanks everyone. Let's lock the copy + a11y fixes into the next patch release. Please drop any final nits in this thread by EOD so we can ship the change.
